title: Microsoft Entra Domain Services: sAMAccountName synchronised from on-premises Active Directory
summary: Hold: the controls table says automation is not documented, but Microsoft's preview Python SDK documents an update operation and the setting it accepts. The feature behaviour, eligible SKUs and hourly billing are supported, and the briefing correctly reports Microsoft's conflicting statements about new-domain defaults.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: API and automation
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation that sets enhanced sAMAccountName synchronisation.
claims.quote: begin_update(resource_group_name: str, domain_service_name: str, domain_service: _models.DomainService, *, content_type: str = 'application/json', **kwargs: Any) -> LROPoller[_models.DomainService]
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api null with kind other, call 'client.domain_services.begin_update(resource_group_name, domain_service_name, domain_service)', and docs https://learn.microsoft.com/python/api/azure-mgmt-domainservices/azure.mgmt.domainservices.operations.domainservicesoperations?view=azure-python-preview. In the note say: 'The preview Python SDK accepts a DomainService whose properties.domain_security_settings.sync_on_prem_sam_account_name sets Enabled or Disabled.' Cite the DomainService, DomainServiceProperties and DomainSecuritySettings model references at https://learn.microsoft.com/python/api/azure-mgmt-domainservices/azure.mgmt.domainservices.models.domainservice?view=azure-python-preview, https://learn.microsoft.com/python/api/azure-mgmt-domainservices/azure.mgmt.domainservices.models.domainserviceproperties?view=azure-python-preview and https://learn.microsoft.com/python/api/azure-mgmt-domainservices/azure.mgmt.domainservices.models.domainsecuritysettings?view=azure-python-preview. These pages explicitly connect the update argument to the setting; this does not assert rollback behaviour.

claims.claim: The setting is configured per managed domain.
claims.quote: Select your managed domain. ... In the left navigation, select Security settings. ... For sAMAccountName synchronization from on-premises, select Enable.

claims.claim: No per-user or per-group selection of the enhanced attribute source is described by the cited pages.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Entra Domain Services sAMAccountName synchronization per user group selection disable existing domain revert pricing separate charge. Read security-account-name and ARM domainServices; scoped-sync results select domain membership, not the attribute-source switch.

claims.claim: Learn does not explain disabling the setting again on an existing domain or the resulting name rollback.
claims.quote: Searched: "sAMAccountName" "Domain Services" "disable" "existing". Read security-account-name, ARM domainServices and preview SDK models/operations. Disabled is an accepted value, but no passage explains reversal on an existing domain or restoration of generated names.
